# Megagis S.R.L.

> Megagis S.R.L. is an ANCPI Class I authorized company based in Târgoviște, Dâmbovița, Romania. We provide comprehensive land cadastre, topography services, and advanced GIS (Geographic Information Systems) solutions across Romania for both the private and public sectors.

## Contact Information
- **Location**: Str. Răsăritului nr. 6, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița, 130050, Romania
- **Phone**: +40 727 323 869
- **Email**: office@megagis.ro
- **Website**: https://megagis.ro
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/megagis/?locale=ro_RO

## Services Offered
1. **Cadastru Sistematic (Systematic Cadastre - PNCCF)**: Systematic property registration in the Integrated Cadastre and Land Registry System.
2. **Topografie Inginerească și Geodezie (Engineering Topography & Geodesy)**: High-precision topographical surveys, stakeouts, and 3D terrain modeling.
3. **GIS și Cartografie Digitală (GIS & Digital Cartography)**: Development of geographic information systems, spatial databases, and digital maps.
4. **Registrul Spațiilor Verzi (Green Space Register - RSV)**: Inventory and mapping of green spaces for local public authorities.
5. **Consultanță Tehnică și Urbanism (Technical Consulting & Urban Planning)**: Specialized consulting for PUG, PUZ, PUD documentation and cadastral approvals.

## Key Facts
- **Certifications**: ANCPI Class I (RO-B-J 2489/2022)
- **Experience**: Over 50+ Systematic Cadastre & Green Spaces Projects, over 100,000 properties and administrative units registered.
